Gifted: Trait Manifestation.description:
🧬 Trait Manifestation, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you turn a hand into a crab's claw, stretch fingers into octopus tentacles, or grow another feature from recent meals, one limb in size, for a few minutes.
📈 With training: a shell for you and someone you hold, wings, squid ink, horns through a wall, a steel-shearing claw, all meals in one form, a crowd caught on tentacles.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as each feature burns the meal it came from.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tamaki Amajiki (Manifest).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Trait Manifestation.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Trait Manifestation family): Scale: the user grows features of animals, fish, shellfish and plants eaten within about a day: claws, shells, tentacles, wings, horns, ink sacs. A new adult user grows one at a time, sized to one body part (forearm-sized claw, tentacles about two meters, wings that glide but cannot climb), holds it a few minutes and switches in a breath. Bigger feats need techniques. If meals were never stated, assume shrimp and squid. Limits: no meal, no feature; hard use burns a meal within the hour. Features keep their creature's weaknesses (shells crack, tentacles tear). It never copies a Quirk and draws nothing from people. Quirk Strain: light: one small feature; moderate: shell, wings, ink, whole limb; heavy: horns, giant claw; severe: every meal at once, dozens of tentacles. Type: Transformation. Law: a grown claw or horn is Quirk use; using one on a person unlicensed is assault.
